trail_en: A homeless ex-coworker 'marries' the defendant's live-in girlfriend on paper.
Same night: a NT$5M accident policy on him — premium just NT$5,670.
Three months later he's hit by a car; he dies weeks later.
The 'wife' files the claim. The defendant? Says he was out shrimp fishing.
trail_zh: 一名街友前同事，跟被告的同居女友「登記結婚」。
當晚就幫他投保500萬意外險，保費只要5,670元。
三個月後他在路上被車撞，幾週後過世。
「太太」出面申請理賠；被告說他那時在釣蝦場。
cracks_en: An agent asked to meet the insured before signing
Headlight glass from a dumped stolen car matched the scene
The 'married couple' never slept on the same floor
The insurer refused to pay out on the NT$5M policy
cracks_zh: 業務員要求簽約前先見被保人本人
棄置贓車的大燈碎片，和現場碎片吻合
這對「夫妻」從沒睡在同一層樓
保險公司拒絕理賠這張500萬保單
reveal_en: Sham marriage, policy, stolen car — all one plan. Murder conviction upheld: life imprisonment; the girlfriend got 12 years, the helper 10.5.
reveal_zh: 假結婚、投保、偷車撞人，全是同一盤計畫。殺人罪定讞，主嫌無期徒刑；同居女友12年、幫手10年6月。

source.id: 最高法院106年度台上字第2808號刑事判決

trail_en: Two new policies in May and June, plus a travel policy two days before the incident.
He says a branch on the median strip pierced his eye as he drove, then he hit the guardrail.
Three insurers pay about NT$3.5M; two refuse.
He also sues the government for state compensation over the 'dangerous tree'.
trail_zh: 5月、6月各新買一張保單，事發前兩天再加保旅平險。
他說開車時被分隔島樹枝刺進眼睛，接著撞上護欄。
三家保險公司共賠約350萬，兩家拒賠。
他還以「路樹危險」向政府請求國家賠償。
cracks_en: His dashcam shows him crawling along the median by bushes
He had held insurance policies going back to 1990
Two insurers refused to pay out on his eye-injury claim
He filed a state-compensation lawsuit and lost it
cracks_zh: 行車紀錄器拍到他貼著分隔島慢開
他從1990年起就一直有在買保單
兩家保險公司拒絕理賠他的眼傷
他打了國家賠償官司，結果敗訴
reveal_en: He injured his own eye on purpose. Fraud: 1 year, final.
reveal_zh: 眼傷是他故意造成的。詐欺罪，判1年定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院108年度上易字第2383號刑事判決

trail_en: Five days before: two travel policies, NT$10M each — for a solo drive to the next district.
He'd bounced cheques; his family says he rarely told them where he went.
Drove 2.3 km in 47 minutes, doubled back once, then left the road on a downhill bend.
His wife claims double cover on his postal life policy. The insurer refuses.
trail_zh: 事發前5天，買了兩張各1,000萬的旅平險，結果只是一個人開車去隔壁區。
他有跳票紀錄；家人說他平常出門很少交代去哪。
2.3公里開了47分鐘，還折返一次，最後在下坡彎道衝出路外。
妻子依郵局壽險申請加倍給付，保險公司拒賠。
cracks_en: Both travel policies had the same start and end dates
He doubled back once on the road before the crash
Reconstruction found the tyre marks followed the bend
Police found no braking marks at the scene of the crash
cracks_zh: 兩張旅平險的起訖日期完全一樣
出事前他曾在路上折返一次
鑑定發現胎痕是順著彎道走的
警方說現場完全沒有煞車痕
reveal_en: The bend had a 15.8 m gap in the guardrail; the court found an accident. Insurer ordered to pay the extra NT$800K. Final.
reveal_zh: 彎道護欄有15.8公尺缺口，法院認定是意外，判保險公司加付80萬。定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺南分院111年度保險上易字第5號民事判決

trail_en: Older brother, a retired cop, holds policies on his younger brother at three insurers.
Two months earlier he bought a deregistered car with no plates.
The younger brother, out cycling, is hit from behind; the driver flees.
Older brother, as beneficiary, collects about NT$9.86M.
trail_zh: 退休警察哥哥，在三家保險公司幫弟弟保了險。
事發兩個月前，他買了一台已報廢、沒掛牌的車。
弟弟騎腳踏車時被從後方撞上，肇事車逃逸。
受益人哥哥領到約985萬元保險金。
cracks_en: The car's red trunk lid had been repainted grey
The car was later dumped in the hills and set on fire
Insurers were still holding back some of the injury claims
A scrap-sale contract tied the burned car back to him
cracks_zh: 車子紅色後車廂蓋被重漆成灰色
車子事後被丟在山區放火燒掉
部分傷害理賠仍被保險公司扣著
報廢車契約把燒毀的車連到他
reveal_en: The 'hit-and-run' was the brother all along. Murder for insurance: life imprisonment, upheld.
reveal_zh: 「肇逃」的駕駛就是哥哥本人。殺人詐保，無期徒刑定讞。

source.id: 最高法院104年度台上字第994號刑事判決

trail_en: Policies bought in March, September and October 2012 — over NT$10M of cover.
January 2013: he reports losing fingertips in a meat-grinder accident.
Insurers pay out at least NT$1.29M.
Paramedics found the grinder unplugged. Later he blamed a grass trimmer instead.
trail_zh: 2012年3月、9月、10月陸續投保，保額超過1,000萬。
2013年1月，他說手指被絞肉機絞斷。
保險公司至少賠了129萬多。
救護人員到場時絞肉機插頭沒插；後來他又改口是割草機。
cracks_en: The grinder was unplugged when the paramedics arrived
Forensics found clean breaks and nails left intact
He later changed his story and blamed a grass trimmer
His total insurance cover added up to over NT$10M
cracks_zh: 救護人員到場時，絞肉機根本沒插電
法醫說斷面整齊、指甲也都完整
他後來改口說是被割草機弄傷的
他的總保額加起來超過1,000萬
reveal_en: The injury was deliberate. Fraud: aggregate 1 year 2 months, final.
reveal_zh: 傷是故意弄的。詐欺罪，應執行1年2月定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺南分院106年度上易字第308號刑事判決

trail_en: A wife holds life and accident policies on her husband; she's the beneficiary.
He's found drowned in a shallow roadside ditch.
The insurer pays the NT$500K life part but refuses the NT$1M accident part.
Its argument: a healthy adult can't drown in water that shallow.
trail_zh: 妻子幫丈夫保了壽險加意外險，自己是受益人。
丈夫被發現溺斃在路旁淺水溝。
保險公司付了50萬壽險，卻拒付100萬意外險。
理由：健康成年人不可能在那麼淺的水裡溺死。
cracks_en: The man who drowned had a history of epilepsy
The ditch where it happened was quite a shallow one
The autopsy found a forehead bruise and a scraped knee
Even the insurer's lawyer had no proof it wasn't an accident
cracks_zh: 死者生前本來就有癲癇的病史
他溺水的那條水溝其實不深
解剖發現額頭瘀傷和膝蓋擦傷
保險公司律師承認拿不出任何反證
reveal_en: Another insurer had already paid. Court: accident — pay NT$1M plus 10% interest. Final.
reveal_zh: 另一家保險公司早就理賠了。法院認定意外，判賠100萬加年息10%。定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺南分院96年度保險上易字第1號民事判決

trail_en: Spring: a wife takes out policies on her husband — without his consent.
She has gambling debts from illegal lottery bets.
He's hospitalised; weeks later he dies in a private room she'd moved him to.
She calls the insurer again and again, and petitions prosecutors four times for the death certificate.
trail_zh: 春天，妻子未經同意幫丈夫投保多張保單。
她簽六合彩欠下賭債。
丈夫住院，幾週後在她要求換的單人病房過世。
她一再打給保險公司，還四度向檢方聲請死亡證明。
cracks_en: A nurse noticed his IV fluid had turned a cloudy orange
She had him moved into a private room at the hospital
She kept pressing the insurer to pay out on the claim
A saved IV bag held pesticide and unprescribed drugs
cracks_zh: 護理師發現點滴變成混濁的橘色
她特地把丈夫轉到單人病房
她三番兩次催保險公司趕快理賠
點滴袋驗出農藥和沒開過的藥
reveal_en: She tampered with his IV twice. Murder for insurance — death sentence, upheld.
reveal_zh: 她兩度在點滴裡動手腳。殺人詐保，死刑定讞。

source.id: 最高法院102年度台上字第2392號刑事判決

trail_en: A business owner with NT$30M+ in debt buys three accident policies in nine days.
He searches online for how disability cover pays out. Days later: a crash.
Suit and flip-flops on a dry, sunny day — he tells police it was raining, and 'insurance will handle it.'
He asks doctors to amputate injured toes. Payout: about NT$9.47M.
trail_zh: 負債3,000多萬的老闆，9天內買了三張意外險。
他上網查失能險怎麼賠，幾天後就出車禍。
大晴天穿西裝配拖鞋，卻跟警察說在下雨，還說「保險會處理」。
他要求醫師截掉受傷腳趾，領到約947萬。
cracks_en: A phone memo added up payouts from five policies
He was wearing flip-flops together with a suit
He told police it was raining on a clear sunny day
He asked the doctors to amputate his injured toes
cracks_zh: 手機備忘錄算好五張保單的錢
他穿西裝卻配了一雙拖鞋
大晴天他卻跟警察說在下雨
他主動要求醫師截掉受傷的腳趾
reveal_en: The plan was written down before the crash. Fraud: 3 years, final.
reveal_zh: 計畫早就寫在手機裡。詐欺罪，判3年定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院115年度上易字第914號刑事判決

trail_en: An unmarried factory worker who also farms has an accident rider worth NT$1M; his sister is the beneficiary.
Before dawn he drinks from a plastic bottle by his bed. It's weedkiller.
The insurer refuses: a farmer would know that smell.
In hospital he insists he grabbed it by mistake and says he has work tomorrow.
trail_zh: 未婚、在藥廠上班兼務農的男子有100萬意外險附約，受益人是妹妹。
天亮前他拿床邊寶特瓶喝了一口，裡面是除草劑。
保險公司拒賠：務農的人不可能聞不出來。
他在醫院堅稱是拿錯，還說明天要上班。
cracks_en: He was in the habit of drinking heavily at night
A pesticide lab found the bottle had no strong smell
He had nearly NT$1M in savings and no debts at all
Days earlier he texted friends asking about their weddings
cracks_zh: 他平常晚上都習慣喝上不少酒
檢驗所說那瓶農藥沒有刺鼻味
他有近百萬存款，也沒有任何負債
幾天前他還傳簡訊跟朋友問婚禮的事
reveal_en: Court: a mix-up in a cluttered room, not intent. Insurer ordered to pay NT$1M. Final.
reveal_zh: 法院認定是在雜亂房間裡拿錯瓶子，不是故意，判保險公司賠100萬。定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院100年度保險上易字第24號民事判決

trail_en: 2019: a cousin buys a life policy in her relative's name, then switches the beneficiary to herself.
More accident and travel cover follows — NT$5M of it bought the very day of the crash.
He's lured out by a fake call 'from the farmers' association' and hit by a scrap car with stolen plates.
He survives. No claim is ever filed.
trail_zh: 2019年，表姊用表弟名義投保壽險，再把受益人改成自己。
接著加保意外險、旅平險——其中500萬是車禍當天才買的。
他被冒稱「農會」的電話約出門，遭掛失竊車牌的報廢車撞擊。
他活了下來，最後沒人申請理賠。
cracks_en: She had paid over NT$170K in premiums on the policies
She later paid the victim NT$6.8M in a settlement
Police reviewing CCTV saw it didn't look like an accident
The hired driver was recruited on Facebook for NT$1M
cracks_zh: 她前後一共繳了17萬多元的保費
她事後跟被害人和解賠了680萬
警方調閱監視器，發現根本就不像意外
撞人的司機是用100萬在臉書找的
reveal_en: Forged signatures, a hired driver, a staged crash. The victim survived. Attempted murder for insurance — 5 years 2 months, final.
reveal_zh: 偽簽投保、雇人開車、製造車禍。被害人幸運活了下來。殺人未遂，判5年2月定讞。

source.id: 最高法院112年度台上字第828號刑事判決（事實見111年度台上字第2973號）

trail_en: Jul 2007–Feb 2008: an older father gets 12 policies on himself, partly through an ex-employer and a friend's company.
Accident and disability cover tops NT$68.5M.
March 2008: his hand is crushed in a metal press at the friend's tiny workshop.
One insurer and labour insurance pay about NT$1.39M; ten insurers refuse.
trail_zh: 2007年7月到2008年2月，年長的父親替自己保了12張保單，部分透過前雇主和朋友公司投保。
意外傷殘保額超過6,850萬。
2008年3月，他在朋友的小鐵工廠被沖床壓碎手掌。
一家保險公司加勞保共賠約139萬，另外十家拒賠。
cracks_en: Premiums of NT$200K+ a year on NT$250–400K income
He had no real work to do at the workshop that day
His account of how the press started kept changing
Ten of his twelve insurers refused to pay the claims
cracks_zh: 保費年繳20萬，所得25至40萬
那天他到工廠，其實根本沒事要做
沖床到底怎麼啟動，他說法一變再變
十二家保險公司裡，有十家都拒絕理賠
reveal_en: He wanted money for his young son's future and staged the injury himself. Fraud: 1 year 2 months on appeal, final.
reveal_zh: 他想替年幼兒子攢教育費，自己製造傷殘。詐欺罪，二審改判1年2月定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院102年度上易字第678號刑事判決

trail_en: A man has a NT$1M group accident policy; his mother is the beneficiary.
He's found face-down at home, wedged in a narrow gap beside his bed.
Tests find sleeping pills — and traces of heroin from the day before.
The insurer refuses: overdose, not accident.
trail_zh: 男子有100萬團體傷害險，受益人是母親。
他被發現趴在家中床邊的狹窄縫隙裡。
檢驗出安眠藥，還有前一天施用海洛因的痕跡。
保險公司拒賠：是用藥過量，不是意外。
cracks_en: He had a known history of liver disease
No drug paraphernalia was found in his home
He had once been sent to compulsory drug rehab
The examiner said the drug level wasn't lethal
cracks_zh: 他生前就有肝臟方面的病史
在他家裡找不到任何吸毒器具
他之前曾經被裁定觀察勒戒過
相驗法醫作證，毒品濃度不足以致命
reveal_en: Court: the main cause was positional suffocation — an accident. Insurer ordered to pay NT$1M. Final.
reveal_zh: 法院認定主因是姿勢性窒息，屬意外，判保險公司賠100萬。定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺中分院105年度保險上易字第8號民事判決

trail_en: A former paper-delivery man suddenly owns a steakhouse and a NT$10M+ home.
Sep 2013–Apr 2014: nine policies on him, NT$46M+ of accident cover; a 'friend' pays the premiums.
1:57 a.m., by a lakeside road: he's hit by a rental car and dies.
A man walks up and tells police he was the driver.
trail_zh: 原本送報的男子，突然當上牛排店老闆，還貸款買了千萬房子。
2013年9月到隔年4月，投保9張保單，意外險額度逾4,600萬，保費由「朋友」出。
凌晨1點57分，澄清湖環湖路，他被一輛租來的車撞擊身亡。
一名男子出面，向警方說車是他開的。
cracks_en: Phone logs caught an 'in position' call before impact
The car scraped the guardrail for 60 m without braking
The victim was on crutches from an earlier 'accident'
The car had only been rented earlier that same evening
cracks_zh: 撞擊前有人打電話回報「就定位」
車子沿護欄擦撞近60公尺都沒煞車
被害人因先前的「意外」拄著拐杖
那輛車是事發當天晚上才租來的
reveal_en: A former insurance agent set him up from the start; the 'driver' was a stand-in. Murder: mastermind life, three others 10–14.5 years, upheld.
reveal_zh: 前保險業務員一手布局，出面的「駕駛」是頂替。殺人罪定讞：主謀無期徒刑，另三人10年2月至14年6月。

source.id: 最高法院109年度台上字第1477號刑事判決（事實見臺灣高等法院高雄分院108年度上更二字第2號）

trail_en: A former insurance agent owing several million crashes into a guardrail, steps into traffic and is hit.
She settles with the other driver for a NT$5–6K red envelope.
Months later X-rays show healed bones and normal nerve tests — yet she arrives at clinics in a wheelchair.
Severe-disability certificates follow; insurers pay out more than NT$4.8M.
trail_zh: 負債數百萬的前保險業務員，自撞護欄後走到車道上被撞。
她跟對方駕駛只收了5、6千元紅包就和解。
幾個月後X光顯示骨折癒合、神經檢查正常，她看診時卻坐輪椅進診間。
她拿到重度失能診斷書，保險公司賠了超過480萬。
cracks_en: She settled with the other driver for a small red envelope
Covert video caught her getting into cars, crossing roads
She owed just one business partner some NT$6–7M
She walked into the road straight after her own crash
cracks_zh: 她只收了一個小紅包就跟對方駕駛和解
側錄影片拍到她自己上下車、過馬路
她光欠一個股東就六、七百萬
她自撞護欄後，馬上走進車道裡
reveal_en: The crash was real; the lasting disability was faked. Fraud: aggregate 3 years 6 months plus 7 months, final.
reveal_zh: 車禍是真的，失能是裝的。詐欺罪，分別應執行3年6月及7月定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺南分院111年度上易字第589號刑事判決（事實見臺灣嘉義地方法院110年度易字第326號）

trail_en: A building manager has daily hospital-cash cover at five insurers — about NT$20K a day in total.
Two of the policies started just days before the crash.
He's hit on his scooter, then stays at three hospitals in a row: 87 days.
Insurers pay for the first 24 days and refuse the last 63.
trail_zh: 大樓管理員在五家保險公司買了住院日額險，合計一天約2萬。
其中兩張在車禍前幾天才生效。
他騎機車被撞，接著連住三家醫院，共87天。
保險公司賠了前24天，後面63天拒賠。
cracks_en: NHI data: average stay for that surgery is 10.9 days
He checked out and back in on the same day, twice
His third hospital's doctor said inpatient care was needed
Labour insurance had already paid 78 days of sick benefit
cracks_zh: 健保資料：該手術平均住10.9天
他兩度當天出院、當天又住院
第三家醫院醫師作證，他確實需要住院
勞保已經給付他78天傷病給付
reveal_en: The car driver broke the traffic rules; the stays were doctor-ordered. Insurers ordered to pay NT$759K. Final.
reveal_zh: 是對方違規撞人，住院也是醫師判斷。法院判兩家保險公司共賠75萬9千元。定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺中分院96年度保險上易字第10號民事判決

trail_en: A man owes about NT$8M from illegal lottery bets.
Over two years he insures his own life for about NT$8.3M, his wife as beneficiary.
A rented car is found at the bottom of a coastal cliff, a body at the wheel in his clothes.
His wife identifies 'him' and collects NT$8.3M. Months later he walks back in the front door.
trail_zh: 男子簽六合彩，欠了親友約800萬。
兩年內替自己投保，總額約830萬，受益人是太太。
一台租來的車墜落蘇花公路斷崖，駕駛座上的屍體穿著他的衣服。
太太指認是「他」，領走830萬。幾個月後，他自己回家了。
cracks_en: He turned himself in, saying it was a hit-and-run in Yilan
The car had been rented only two days before it went over
The body was dressed in his clothes, watch and glasses
The dead man's father said he'd never once been to Yilan
cracks_zh: 他自首，說是在宜蘭撞到人才起意
那台車是出事前兩天才租的
屍體穿戴著他的衣服、手錶和眼鏡
死者父親說兒子從沒去過宜蘭
reveal_en: His 'accident' story collapsed: he had picked a stranger who resembled him and killed him to fake his own death. Murder: life imprisonment, upheld.
reveal_zh: 「車禍」說法不攻自破：他找了一個身形相似的陌生人殺害，假冒自己死亡。殺人罪，無期徒刑定讞。

source.id: 最高法院87年度台上字第2599號刑事判決

trail_en: A 2016 crash leaves a man with a fractured wrist.
The fracture heals, but he tells doctors his fingers no longer work.
Compulsory auto insurance pays NT$560K; labour insurance adds NT$317K.
The insurer then sues the other driver to recover the money. She smells a rat.
trail_zh: 2016年一場車禍，男子手腕骨折。
骨折癒合了，他卻跟醫師說手指不能動。
強制險賠了56萬，勞保又給了31萬多。
保險公司轉向對方駕駛求償，她覺得不對勁。
cracks_en: His fractured wrist had fully healed by the time he claimed
A fake 'delivery man' filmed him writing and peeling tape
Labour insurance had separately paid him NT$316,800
The insurer had gone after the other driver for its money
cracks_zh: 他申請理賠時，腕骨其實早已癒合
假送貨員拍到他寫字、撕膠帶
勞保另外給付了他31萬多元
保險公司回頭向對方駕駛求償
reveal_en: The other driver's brother posed as a courier and caught him using both hands. Fraud: 5 months in total, final.
reveal_zh: 對方駕駛的哥哥假扮送貨員，拍到他雙手靈活。詐欺罪，合計5個月定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院高雄分院110年度上易字第483號刑事判決

trail_en: A brand-new car, three months old, insured for NT$2.3M against damage.
Night, on the freeway: the driver says a shiny object flew over from the other side.
She drives on home without stopping or calling the highway police.
The repair bill is NT$779K. The insurer refuses: 12 evenly spaced holes don't fit her story.
trail_zh: 一台才買三個月的新車，車體險保額230萬。
夜間國道上，駕駛說有發亮物體從對向車道飛過來。
她沒停車也沒報國道警察，直接開回家。
修車花了77萬多。保險公司拒賠：12個等距破洞不合理。
cracks_en: She didn't stop or report it to the highway police that night
The underbody had 12 holes spaced about 16 cm apart
The damage ran in one straight line, bumper to underbody
She reported the incident online after midnight
cracks_zh: 她當晚沒有停車，也沒向警方報案
底盤有12個間隔約16公分的破洞
車損從保險桿到底盤連成一直線
她隔天凌晨才上網向警方報案
reveal_en: A straight line of damage is what you'd expect from running over debris at speed — and nobody wrecks a 3-month-old car on purpose. Insurer ordered to pay NT$778,550. Final.
reveal_zh: 高速碾過墜落物，本來就會留下一直線的損傷；也沒人會故意弄壞剛買三個月的新車。判保險公司賠77萬8,550元，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院114年度保險上易字第8號民事判決

trail_en: A foot-massage worker owes NT$5M from co-signing a friend's loan.
He insures his estranged wife with four new policies — NT$6M in total.
He calls her back from Taipei, saying his mother is ill and needs care.
Next day she's found drowned in a pond where he'd gone fishing. He's in the water shouting for help.
trail_zh: 做腳底按摩的男子，替朋友作保背了500萬債。
他替分居的妻子新買四張保單，合計600萬。
他騙妻子說婆婆生病，要她從台北回來照顧。
隔天妻子溺死在他釣魚的池塘，他泡在水裡喊救命。
cracks_en: The autopsy found smothering injuries to her gums and upper lip
He'd cancelled one policy to buy cover that paid out more
He'd been behind on his health-insurance premiums for years
A neighbour heard him shouting and ran to the pond
cracks_zh: 解剖發現牙齦和嘴唇有悶壓傷
他退掉一張保單，改買賠更多的
他已經欠繳健保費好幾年了
鄰居聽到呼救聲才趕到池塘邊
reveal_en: The water by the bank was too shallow to drown in; he held her under. Murder: life imprisonment, upheld.
reveal_zh: 岸邊水淺淹不死人，是他把她壓進水裡。殺人罪，無期徒刑定讞。

source.id: 最高法院102年度台上字第1273號刑事判決

trail_en: A university student is injured in a 2009 road crash.
Afterwards he says he's completely blind; he arrives at clinics with a cane, in a wheelchair.
Eye tests come back normal; one doctor notes malingering 'can't be ruled out'.
Three insurers pay NT$5.2M. He also sues the other driver for NT$13.8M.
trail_zh: 一名大學生在2009年車禍受傷。
之後他說自己全盲，拿著手杖、坐輪椅去看診。
眼睛檢查結果正常，醫師寫下「不排除裝病」。
三家保險公司賠了520萬，他還向對方駕駛求償1,384萬。
cracks_en: His eye tests kept coming back with normal results
A doctor wrote that malingering couldn't be ruled out
He also sued the other driver for more than NT$13 million
Blogs and Facebook posts showed him moving around freely
cracks_zh: 他的眼睛檢查結果一直都正常
醫師病歷寫著「不排除裝病」
他向對方駕駛求償超過1,300萬
部落格和臉書上的他行動自如
reveal_en: The other driver did the digging and found the posts. Fraud: 1 year 2 months, final.
reveal_zh: 是被求償的對方駕駛自己挖出那些貼文。詐欺罪，判1年2月定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院高雄分院103年度上易字第574號刑事判決

trail_en: A husband holds life policies with accident riders; his wife is the beneficiary.
One afternoon he goes to a paid fishing pond, chatting cheerfully with the others.
He's pulled from the water and dies in hospital.
The insurer refuses NT$1.2M: he was a strong swimmer, and it blames heart disease.
trail_zh: 丈夫保了壽險加意外險，受益人是妻子。
那天下午他到釣魚池釣魚，還跟其他釣客有說有笑。
他落水被救起，送醫不治。
保險公司拒付120萬：他水性很好，應是心血管疾病。
cracks_en: The bank dropped steeply straight into water 2.1 metres deep
The pond keeper said he was cheerful that afternoon
The death certificate listed the manner as 'unconfirmed'
The examiner's report mentioned heart disease as a factor
cracks_zh: 池邊陡坡直落2.1公尺深水
釣魚池管理人說他那天心情很好
相驗證明書的死亡方式寫「未確認」
相驗報告提到心血管疾病的可能
reveal_en: Anglers sat right on a slope you couldn't stand on; no clinic had ever treated him for his heart. Accident — pay NT$1.2M. Final.
reveal_zh: 釣位緊貼站不住的陡坡，他也從沒看過心血管門診。法院認定意外，判賠120萬，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院高雄分院92年度保險上易字第8號民事判決

trail_en: A man with a chemistry background insures his new wife: NT$25M of accident cover.
He keeps bringing home leftover engine oil — and the empty cans — from the petrol station.
Visiting her parents, he complains of stomach pain and gets driven to an ER.
While he's at the hospital, the house burns. She dies in the fire.
trail_zh: 念過化工的男子替新婚妻子投保，意外險共2,500萬。
他幾次到加油站換機油，都把剩油連罐子帶回家。
回岳家那晚，他說肚子痛，要人載去急診。
他人在醫院時，岳家起火，妻子葬身火場。
cracks_en: He'd kept bringing home the leftover oil cans
He was at an ER with stomach pain when it caught fire
GHB was found in her blood and in the cup of milk
Her mother grew suspicious once he went after the payout
cracks_zh: 他一直把剩下的機油罐帶回家
起火時他人正在急診看肚子痛
她的血液和那杯牛奶都驗出GHB
他一申請理賠，岳母就起了疑心
reveal_en: He drugged her milk and set a delayed-ignition fire to give himself an alibi. Murder: life imprisonment, upheld.
reveal_zh: 他在牛奶下藥，再用延遲點火裝置製造不在場證明。殺人罪，無期徒刑定讞。

source.id: 最高法院97年度台上字第6296號刑事判決

trail_en: A man's leg is badly scalded.
His story: at a friend's place he dodged the dog, tripped on the hot-plate cord and upset the hot pot.
Six insurers pay out about NT$1.08M.
The friend and the friend's uncle back up his account.
trail_zh: 男子的腿嚴重燙傷。
他說在朋友家為了閃狗，絆到電磁爐的線，打翻火鍋。
六家保險公司共賠了約108萬。
朋友和朋友的舅舅都幫他作證。
cracks_en: He said he tripped on the cord while dodging a dog
The burn was too even and complete for a spill
Six different insurers each paid out on the claim
His friend and the friend's uncle backed up his story
cracks_zh: 他說閃狗時絆到電磁爐電線
燙傷太均勻完整，不像打翻
六家不同的保險公司都付了理賠
朋友和朋友的舅舅都幫他作證
reveal_en: An accidental scald is patchy; his looked poured on deliberately. Fraud: 1 year 6 months, the helpers 1 year 2 months and 10 months. Final.
reveal_zh: 意外燙傷形狀不規則，他的傷卻像刻意澆上去的。詐欺罪：本人1年6月，幫手1年2月、10月，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院高雄分院102年度上易字第901號刑事判決

trail_en: A woman holds a NT$2M personal accident policy.
She says she fell on the stairs at home; that night she's at two ERs.
Surgery for a herniated neck disc leaves her able to do light work only.
Her first claim form never mentioned a fall. The insurer: no bruises, just wear and tear.
trail_zh: 婦人有一張200萬的個人傷害險。
她說在家樓梯跌倒，當晚跑了兩家急診。
頸椎椎間盤突出開刀後，只能做輕便工作。
她第一次申請時沒提跌倒。保險公司說沒擦傷，是退化。
cracks_en: Her first claim form didn't mention any fall
She had no bruises or scrapes from the stairs
She went to two different hospital ERs that same night
The MRI showed the discs on either side weren't worn at all
cracks_zh: 她第一次申請時根本沒提到跌倒
她跌下樓梯卻沒有瘀青擦傷
她當晚連跑了兩家不同醫院的急診
核磁共振顯示鄰近椎間盤沒退化
reveal_en: Healthy neighbouring discs point to trauma, not ageing — and the ER notes that night already said she'd fallen. Insurer ordered to pay NT$800K. Final.
reveal_zh: 鄰近椎間盤健康，代表是外傷不是退化；當晚急診紀錄也寫了跌倒。判保險公司賠80萬，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺中分院105年度保險上易字第4號民事判決

trail_en: A man with about NT$1.7M of card debt takes his brother, who can't hear or speak, to Hunan.
The story: visiting the brother's new wife there.
Before they leave, he buys NT$5M of accidental-death cover through the travel agency.
The brother dies in a hotel room and is cremated in China. The claim stalls on paperwork.
trail_zh: 卡債約170萬的男子，帶著聽障又不能說話的弟弟去湖南。
理由是去看弟弟在當地娶的新太太。
出發前，他透過旅行社替弟弟買了500萬意外險。
弟弟死在旅館房間，在大陸火化。理賠卡在文件不全。
cracks_en: He'd bought the NT$5M cover through the travel agency
The caught hitman phoned him; he promised to pay up
The brother's body was cremated before leaving China
The insurer stalled because his documents were incomplete
cracks_zh: 那500萬意外險是透過旅行社買的
落網殺手打給他，他答應付錢
弟弟的遺體在大陸就先火化了
因為文件不齊，保險公司遲遲沒賠
reveal_en: He'd hired a local man for RMB 200K, payable 'once the insurance comes through'. Murder: life imprisonment, upheld.
reveal_zh: 他以人民幣20萬雇用當地人行兇，說好「保險金下來就付」。殺人罪，無期徒刑定讞。

source.id: 最高法院99年度台上字第5360號刑事判決

trail_en: A claims investigator at a life insurer breaks his neck in a crash.
Afterwards he's certified as paralysed in all four limbs.
He claims from his own employer, another insurer and labour insurance.
All three refuse. He knows exactly how claims get checked.
trail_zh: 壽險公司的理賠調查員，車禍頸椎骨折。
之後他拿到四肢癱瘓的診斷。
他向自己公司、另一家保險公司和勞保申請。
三方全部拒賠。他最清楚理賠怎麼查。
cracks_en: He worked as a claims investigator for an insurer
Every one of his three claims was turned down
His neck really had been fractured in the earlier crash
His ex-boss's photos and lift CCTV showed him walking
cracks_zh: 他本身就是保險公司的理賠調查員
他提出的三筆申請全部被拒
他的頸椎確實在車禍中骨折
跟拍照片和電梯畫面都見他走路
reveal_en: The neck injury was real; the paralysis wasn't. Attempted fraud: 1 year 6 months, halved to 9 months under a commutation act. Final.
reveal_zh: 頸椎骨折是真的，癱瘓是裝的。詐欺未遂，判1年6月，依減刑條例減為9月定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院高雄分院104年度上易字第655號刑事判決

trail_en: A son insures his elderly mother: NT$1.3M of accidental-death cover.
Fourteen months later she goes out gathering oysters in knee-deep water.
A neighbour heads back first; later she's found in the harbour.
The insurer refuses: the forensic report mentions cardiogenic shock.
trail_zh: 兒子替年邁母親投保，意外身故保額130萬。
14個月後，她到水深及膝的海邊採蚵。
鄰居先回港，她後來在港內被找到。
保險公司拒賠：法醫報告寫了心因性休克。
cracks_en: No clinic had ever treated her for any heart trouble
The forensic report listed cardiogenic shock as a cause
The water where she worked was only knee-deep
Her son bought the cover just 14 months earlier
cracks_zh: 她從沒因心臟問題看過任何醫生
法醫報告死因列了心因性休克
她採蚵的地方水只到膝蓋深
兒子才在14個月前替她投保
reveal_en: Mud deep in her nose showed she drowned; with no heart history, the insurer couldn't prove illness caused it. Pay NT$1.3M. Final.
reveal_zh: 鼻腔滿是泥沙，證明是溺水；她沒有心臟病史，保險公司無法證明是病發。判賠130萬，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺南分院98年度保險上易字第5號民事判決

trail_en: A son who quit his job, with about NT$3.18M of debt, makes himself beneficiary of his father's policy.
He adds NT$7M of travel cover 'for a trip to Kaohsiung' that never happens.
His father, on dialysis, ends up in an irrigation canal. The son says he slipped upstream.
A couple offers to help him search downstream; he says no.
trail_zh: 負債約318萬的失業兒子，把父親保單受益人改成自己。
他又以「去高雄玩」為由加保700萬旅平險，旅行根本沒成行。
洗腎的父親落入灌溉圳溝。兒子說他在上游滑倒。
路過的夫婦要載他去找，他拒絕了。
cracks_en: The Kaohsiung trip on the travel policy never happened
He turned down a couple's offer to help him search
His father was on dialysis when a policy was 'signed'
The insurers found many doubts in his claims
cracks_zh: 旅平險上的高雄之行從沒成行
路過夫婦想載他找人，他卻拒絕
保單「簽名」時，父親其實正在洗腎
保險公司對他的理賠疑點重重
reveal_en: He forged his father's signatures, then pushed him into the canal. Murder: life imprisonment, upheld.
reveal_zh: 他偽簽父親的名字投保，再把父親推下圳溝。殺人罪，無期徒刑定讞。

source.id: 最高法院100年度台上字第4867號刑事判決

trail_en: A man rents a steel-framed shed and opens a 'gift warehouse'.
He insures the stock inside for NT$6M against fire.
Months later, around midnight, it burns down. The fire spreads to a hardware shop where a couple is asleep.
Next morning he reports the loss to the insurer.
trail_zh: 男子租下一間鐵架平房，開了「禮品倉庫」。
他替裡面的貨物保了600萬火險。
幾個月後半夜大火，還延燒到有夫妻在睡覺的五金行。
隔天早上他就向保險公司報案。
cracks_en: No sign of a wiring fault was found near the origin
The 'stock' was two suitcases and piles of foam matting
The fire spread to a hardware shop with a couple asleep
His partner couldn't be found, and his house had been razed
cracks_zh: 起火處附近沒發現電線短路痕跡
「貨物」只有兩只旅行箱和泡棉
火還延燒到有夫妻在睡覺的五金行
同夥找不到人，住處已被夷平
reveal_en: His partner lit the foam under the middle rack; there was nothing of value to lose. Arson for insurance, upheld; police moved before a claim was filed.
reveal_zh: 同夥在中間鐵架下點燃泡棉，裡面根本沒有值錢貨。放火詐保罪名定讞，警方介入，保險金沒領到。

source.id: 最高法院95年度台上字第5982號刑事判決

trail_en: A woman is covered by NT$1M of group accident insurance through her father's job.
On a December evening she goes for a walk at a beach park.
Fishermen catching eels nearby pull her from the sea; she can't be saved.
The insurer refuses, pointing to her medical history: why was she in the water at all?
trail_zh: 女子透過父親工作單位，有100萬團體意外險。
12月的傍晚，她到黃金海岸散步。
附近捕鰻苗的漁民把她從海裡救起，仍然不治。
保險公司拒賠，搬出她的病史：她怎麼會在海裡？
cracks_en: The insurer pointed to her psychiatric medical history
The death certificate listed the manner of death as unknown
The fishermen said they hadn't seen her playing in the water
The insurer's own report said the spot had deadly currents
cracks_zh: 保險公司提出她的精神科病史
相驗證明書的死亡方式寫「不詳」
撈起她的漁民說沒看到她玩水
保險公司自己的報告說水流險惡
reveal_en: Two currents meet there at high tide — even the insurer's local office concluded it was likely an accident. Pay NT$1M. Final.
reveal_zh: 那裡是兩股潮水交會處，又正逢漲潮；連保險公司自己的通訊處都認為多半是意外。判賠100萬，定讞。

source.id: 臺灣高等法院臺南分院99年度保險上易字第9號民事判決
